Dossier v1.0

Mobile tactical roguelike · design dossier v1.0

Every death becomes a boss on the 100th floor.

A portrait, offline-first tactical RPG where your corpse keeps your build. Ten stat points derive one of 50 callings. The hero you lose becomes the enemy you must fight back down to reclaim.

Boss floor · every 10

The Echo loop

Death is a place, not a reset.

The only true loss is the time you choose not to spend. The dungeon keeps everything else.

The hero falls

HP reaches zero. The run ends permanently. Kit, gear, and the death tile are stamped into the floor.

The Echo wakes

A named AI combatant now holds that floor, scored from the same skills you used — desaturated, slower, wrong.

A new hero descends

Ten points make a different calling. Layouts, secrets, shortcuts, and corpses are exactly where you left them.

Reclaim or fall again

Beat the Echo to recover its gear and memory. Fail, and the floor keeps another corpse with your name on it.

Stat-Lock engine

50 callings from one allocation.

Allocate 10 points across six stats. Secrets resolve first, the two highest stats pick a lane, and thresholds inside the lane pick the class. Every legal build resolves to exactly one calling.

The descent

Five bands. One hundred floors.

Each band changes a rule, not just a tileset. Floors 1–10 teach; 11–90 procedurally vary; 91–100 become a fixed gauntlet.

FloorsBandThemeNew ruleBosses
1–10The ThresholdCollapsed guild barracks, moss, candlelightTutorial: AP, flanking, traps, extractionThe Gatekeeper
11–30The WarrensFlooded tunnels, fungus, fire ventsElemental hazards; WIS trap detectionThe Flood · The Brood Mother
31–60The DepthsBlack masonry, forges, bone cathedralsElites; mini-bosses every 5; durability pressureThe Forge Saint · The Choir · The Warden
61–90The AbyssInverted rooms, starless voids, mirror hallsReality rules per floor: gravity, mirrors, loopsThe Mirror · The Hollow King · The Unmade
91–100The ZenithGold, white marble, impossible lightFixed gauntlet; no extraction until 100The First Echo
